cornell.cite: Fraser et al., npj Clean Air 1:39 (2025). https://www.nature.com/articles/s44407-025-00037-2
cornell.what: Daily-max PM2.5 vs modeled no-toll counterfactual, first 6 months

goldberg_did.cite: Goldberg et al., Variable Short-Term Air Quality Impacts of New York City's Congestion Pricing Policy. Research Square preprint (2025). https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-8158429/v1
goldberg_did.what: Difference-in-differences on daily-averaged PM2.5 at six real-time NYCCAS sites; coefficients in µg/m³, not percent.
goldberg_did.periods: July 2023–June 2024 control season vs July 2024–June 2025 experimental season; seasonal boundary January 5.
goldberg_did.method: Each site: change from July 1–January 4 to January 5–June 30 in 2024–25 minus the corresponding change in 2023–24. Hourly sensor readings calibrated using temperature and relative humidity, then averaged by day.

sbu.cite: De Jesus et al. (2026), Impacts of New York City's Congestion Pricing Policy on PM2.5 in the South Bronx: Evidence from a Community-Managed Air Sensor Network. https://www.southbronxunite.org/s/DeJesus-Congestion-Pricing-Abstract.pdf
sbu.what: Adjusted step estimates in hourly PM2.5; 19 monitors, January 2024–December 2025
sbu.peak_site: Highway-adjacent South Bronx monitor; address not identified in public abstract
sbu.coordinate_note: Legacy map coordinates retained as approximate regional context, not a verified peak-monitor location.
sbu.method: Generalized additive mixed models adjusting for seasonality, temperature, humidity, wind speed and residential heating; monitor random effects and AR1 autocorrelation.
sbu.status: Public abstract; campaign describes study as undergoing peer review. Raw monitor observations were not obtained or recomputed by this project.

dohmh.cite: NYC DOHMH Congestion Pricing Air Quality Report. https://a816-dohbesp.nyc.gov/IndicatorPublic/data-features/congestion-pricing-report/
dohmh.what: Integrated NYCCAS monitors, one year, Van Wyck Expwy as non-affected control
dohmh.finding: No statistically significant congestion-pricing-attributable change at CRZ or EJ highway corridors

asthma.cite: NYC Environment & Health Data Portal, Hunts Point–Mott Haven. https://a816-dohbesp.nyc.gov/IndicatorPublic/neighborhood-reports/hunts_point_mott_haven/asthma_and_the_environment/
